title: Yellow Creamy Brazilian Cornmeal Pilaf
description: A floral and creamy weeknight Brazilian dish featuring fine yellow cornmeal, this pilaf is a low-carb-friendly option for a quick dinner.
instructions: Bring the chicken broth to a boil in a large saucepan.
Gradually whisk in the fine yellow cornmeal and reduce heat to medium.
Cook for 5 minutes or until the cornmeal is slightly tender.
Shock the cornmeal mixture in an ice bath to stop cooking.
In a large skillet, melt the unsalted butter over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the heavy cream and bring to a simmer.
Add the cooked cornmeal mixture, dried parsley, salt, and black pepper to the skillet.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes or until the pilaf is creamy and heated through.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
